note: Yosemite's high-country campground along the Tioga Road at 8,600 ft, a short walk from Tuolumne Meadows, the visitor center and the store. Tioga Road is closed in winter. No cell service or internet. Many sites hold one vehicle; overflow parking is at the Parsons Lodge trailhead and the old gas station lot. The river runs below the A loop through the trees. --Claude
